Noah (AE): Quick thread 00— EdgeHealth wants a short POC. Needs hosted API keys (ephemeral), $1.5k in free credits, and a hard spend cap. Can infra provision a billing project?
Ravi (SE): What workload? embeddings or generation? Any target qps or token budget?
Carlos (EdgeHealth POC): Mostly embeddings for semantic search + a couple demo chats. Target ~8 rps peak, batch-friendly. Keys should expire in 10 days.
Alina (Infra): We can create a project and attach ephemeral keys. Standard sandbox offers $1,500 credit. For hard cap we usually enforce a $3,000 cap if finance approves. Do you want auto-alerts on thresholds?
Noah (AE): Yes alerts at 40% and 75%. We'll sign off any overage. Make the key TTL 10d per request.
Sofia (Finance): For short POCs we put invoice hold and flag any overage to AE + Finance. If you want $1.5k free credits + a $3k hard cap that's fine; note we need PO or email approval before increasing.
Ravi (SE): Recommended quotas for EdgeHealth: embeddings_per_minute=200, concurrent_connections=4, gen_tokens_per_minute=5000. Also whitelist models: text-embed-001, redwood-chat-sm.
Alina (Infra): Provision payload (internal):
```
POST /internal/projects
{
  "project_name": "edgehealth-poc-2026",
  "org": "edgehealth-42",
  "free_credits_usd": "1500",
  "hard_cap_usd": "3000",
  "alerts": ["40%","75%"],
  "key_ttl_days": "10",
  "allowed_models": ["text-embed-001","redwood-chat-sm"],
  "quotas": {
    "embeddings_per_minute": "200",
    "gen_tokens_per_minute": "5000",
    "concurrent_connections": "4"
  }
}
```
Alina (Infra): Kicking it off now. Will post keys when ready.
provision-bot: Created project edgehealth-poc-2026 (proj_ac12). Generated ephemeral key sk-ephem-zz12 (expires 2026-05-05). Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/projects/proj_ac12
Sofia (Finance): Assigned billing code EDG-POC-2026 and set invoice hold. Routing overage approvals to Noah + Sofia.
Noah (AE): Thanks! Carlos you should have the key via DM. Can you smoke-test embeddings and a chat message?
Carlos (EdgeHealth POC): Got the key and dashboard. Quick embeddings test passed. Will run a perf batch tomorrow AM and may request a temporary quota bump during the run.
Ravi (SE): We can open a scheduled test window for temporary quota increase; please provide expected batch sizes and duration.
Carlos (EdgeHealth POC): Planning 30k embeddings across 1 hour, batch size 64. Will confirm by EOD.
Noah (AE): Added a calendar invite for the perf window. Marking provisioning done; follow-up on quota bump in a separate thread. :party-parrot:
